description: UK conventional gilt conventions: semiannual coupons accruing Actual/Actual (ICMA) on unadjusted quasi-coupon periods, coupon dates generated backward from maturity, payment Following, settlement T+1 on the UnitedKingdom calendar, redemption 100, yield quoted Actual/Actual (ICMA) Compounded Semiannual. Trade-only preset (fixed_rate_bond); the discount curve comes from the market.
provenance: UK Debt Management Office, Formulae for Calculating Gilt Prices from Yields (published 8 June 1998, effective 1 November 1998): https://www.dmo.gov.uk/media/gxraurqc/yldeqns_v1.pdf (actual/actual accrued interest, semi-annual quasi-coupon dates, compounding on quasi-coupon dates); Actual/Actual (ICMA) as implemented by QuantLib 1.44 ActualActual::ISMA, https://github.com/lballabio/QuantLib/blob/v1.44/ql/time/daycounters/actualactual.hpp

field_provenance.trades.fixed_rate_bond.settlement_days: T+1: conventional gilts settle the business day after trade date (gilt market practice; the DMO paper discounts to the settlement date) (UK DMO, Formulae for Calculating Gilt Prices from Yields, https://www.dmo.gov.uk/media/gxraurqc/yldeqns_v1.pdf)
field_provenance.trades.fixed_rate_bond.schedule.calendar: UnitedKingdom: the engine's Calendar enum for the UK (QuantLib UnitedKingdom) (UK DMO, Formulae for Calculating Gilt Prices from Yields, https://www.dmo.gov.uk/media/gxraurqc/yldeqns_v1.pdf)
field_provenance.trades.fixed_rate_bond.schedule.conventi: Unadjusted: coupon periods run calendar date to calendar date; accrual is on the unadjusted dates (UK DMO, Formulae for Calculating Gilt Prices from Yields, https://www.dmo.gov.uk/media/gxraurqc/yldeqns_v1.pdf)
field_provenance.trades.fixed_rate_bond.schedule.terminat: Unadjusted: the maturity date is the calendar date (UK DMO, Formulae for Calculating Gilt Prices from Yields, https://www.dmo.gov.uk/media/gxraurqc/yldeqns_v1.pdf)
field_provenance.trades.fixed_rate_bond.schedule.date_gen: Backward: coupon dates are generated from the maturity date, a short first period if any (UK DMO, Formulae for Calculating Gilt Prices from Yields, https://www.dmo.gov.uk/media/gxraurqc/yldeqns_v1.pdf)
field_provenance.trades.fixed_rate_bond.schedule.end_of_m: false: coupon dates keep the maturity date's day of month (UK DMO, Formulae for Calculating Gilt Prices from Yields, https://www.dmo.gov.uk/media/gxraurqc/yldeqns_v1.pdf)
field_provenance.trades.fixed_rate_bond.frequency: Semiannual: conventional gilts pay on the semi-annual quasi-coupon cycle defined by the maturity date (UK DMO, Formulae for Calculating Gilt Prices from Yields, https://www.dmo.gov.uk/media/gxraurqc/yldeqns_v1.pdf)
field_provenance.trades.fixed_rate_bond.accrual_day_count: Actual/Actual (ICMA): the actual/actual accrued interest convention for gilts (effective 1 November 1998); the engine's DayCounter ActualActualISMA = QuantLib 1.44 ActualActual::ISMA, https://github.com/lballabio/QuantLib/blob/v1.44/ql/time/daycounters/actualactual.hpp
field_provenance.trades.fixed_rate_bond.payment_conventio: Following: a coupon falling on a non-business day is paid on the next business day; accrual itself is Unadjusted (market practice, stated here as such: the cited source https://www.dmo.gov.uk/media/gxraurqc/yldeqns_v1.pdf fixes the accrual and yield formulae, not the payment-date adjustment)
field_provenance.trades.fixed_rate_bond.redemption: 100: redeemed at par (UK DMO, Formulae for Calculating Gilt Prices from Yields, https://www.dmo.gov.uk/media/gxraurqc/yldeqns_v1.pdf)
field_provenance.trades.fixed_rate_bond.yield.day_counter: Actual/Actual (ICMA): the actual/actual accrued interest convention for gilts (effective 1 November 1998); the engine's DayCounter ActualActualISMA = QuantLib 1.44 ActualActual::ISMA, https://github.com/lballabio/QuantLib/blob/v1.44/ql/time/daycounters/actualactual.hpp
field_provenance.trades.fixed_rate_bond.yield.compounding: Compounded: the quoted yield compounds once per coupon period (UK DMO, Formulae for Calculating Gilt Prices from Yields, https://www.dmo.gov.uk/media/gxraurqc/yldeqns_v1.pdf)
field_provenance.trades.fixed_rate_bond.yield.frequency: Semiannual: conventional gilts pay on the semi-annual quasi-coupon cycle defined by the maturity date; the yield compounds at the coupon frequency (UK DMO, Formulae for Calculating Gilt Prices from Yields, https://www.dmo.gov.uk/media/gxraurqc/yldeqns_v1.pdf)
